verified_behaviors: Committed lookup precedes new-effect time/action/model/repair admission; stored exact outcomes replay through current pure projections without another outbound call/counter reservation.

Frozen manifest pins effective request/context/binding, controller and critical C06/C14 source fingerprint, runtime class/configuration hash, model, limits, actor binding and catalogue policy revision. Current C17 authorization/policy checks remain fresh.

Tool outcomes retain exact status/body and accepted/discarded reason; model outcomes retain exact C06 content/status/finish/elapsed/nullableusage/cap privately. Hash and deterministic reconstructed projection verified before reuse.
Lost tool/model/repair commit acknowledgements replay committed results. Uncommitted physical model retry may repeat and bill again; model count increases again.
Prepared pure repair reservation survives interruption without consuming a second logical repair; second malformed output still stops.
Committed evidence reconstructed at180seconds/12actions and sticky invalid clock before refusing new effects.
Late model return retained as discarded and never accepted as successful evidence during replay.
Explicit linked child segment may reuse verified pre-model pin/inventory prefix; parent terminal model/repair/finish decisions are not seeded.
Counter-only nonzero restoration without a journal is rejected; configuration/request drift, corruption, invalid C06 metadata and machine journal errors fail safely.
limitations: Actual database transactions, attempt-time settlement, lease fencing, terminal event publication, API and frontend are owned by parent/store agents and require their own acceptance.
Terminal redelivery must return stored terminal state in the durable service; the controller port is for active replay.
The host settles unresolved pending active time before restoration; lease expiry does not prove an old RPC stopped.
Exact raw outcomes are owner-private journal data; public events must use safe controlled summaries.
No exactly-once provider billing or execution claim; no live models, cloud resources, real data or legacy work was invoked.
Original C19 receipts/tests remain immutable; only the two explicitly owned C19 source paths are intentionally superseded.
